scope: cmdmisc.c added stddef and command guest-state include; resolve with scalar producer and consumers

findings.claim: Memory epoch expiry by itself proves original aliases unsafe during normal execution
findings.evidence: Production mvdm_standalone_worker.c begins memory registration once at worker startup and ends it during worker cleanup after producer and WOW retirement. The execution_run_until_return alternative is explicitly a bounded fixture bridge, not evidence of recurring production epochs.

findings.claim: Current header dependency proves adaptation necessary
findings.evidence: stddef supplies offsetof for new scalar registration only. cmdmisc consumers and cmdpif/DEM/FDC consumers use the new accessor by local choice; this is not an independent original failure.

findings.claim: GetVDMAddr returns an alias tied to a physical mapping
findings.evidence: softpc.h -> Sim32pGetVDMPointerWithLinear -> NtGetPtrToLinAddrByte -> c_GetLinAdd -> c_GetPhyAdd; c_GetLinAdd translates when paging is enabled. Mapping capability alone does not prove these DOSDATA scalars are remapped.

findings.claim: Scalar registration points originate in original guest DOSDATA
findings.evidence: msinit.asm loads DS:DX SCS_COMSPEC, DS:BX SCS_Is_Dos_Binary, DS:CX SCS_FDACCESS before SVC_CMDSETINFO. lmstub.asm defines the fields in DOSDATA.

remaining_question: Determine actual mapping/instance contract of these registered DOSDATA scalar locations across selected guest transitions and asynchronous FDC accesses; distinguish shared kernel data from per-VM buffers. No arbitrary paging counterexample admitted as a reproduced product failure.
counter_review: Do not remove registration alone: nt_fdisk/nt_rflop/demmisc/cmdpif still consume it. No production or guest edits, no build required. Do not mark file complete.
